verdict.rationale: Riveter is a data extraction and enrichment API, so chunking very large tables is a fair axis for it. The evidence documents only a per-request cap of 10,000 rows and SDK pagination of results; neither is a product-provided chunking mechanism for large inputs. No evidence shows the product itself splits large tables to fit processing limits, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract data from very large tables using intelligent chunking so it fits within processing limits
